## Fixed

- **CLI silently did nothing under a real `npm install -g` / `npx` invocation.**
  `install`/`configure`/`validate`/`version` all gated on an "is this the entry module"
  check (`import.meta.url === file://${process.argv[1]}`), which broke the moment this ran
  through npm's own bin symlink: Node resolves `import.meta.url` to the symlink's real
  target, but leaves `process.argv[1]` as the symlink path exactly as invoked, so the two
  never matched. Confirmed live — packed the tarball, `npm install -g` from it into a
  scratch prefix, ran the resulting `bin/readyset-flow` symlink, got silent success with
  zero output. Fixed by resolving `process.argv[1]` to its real path (`fs.realpathSync`)
  before comparing.

  Every version before this one has the bug — anyone who installed `readyset-flow` the
  normal way (not by pointing `node` at the file directly) got a CLI that did nothing.

## Install

```
npx readyset-flow install
```
or
```
bunx readyset-flow install
```

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/fresp/readyset-flow/compare/0.9.1...0.9.2
